site.domainNote: Desktop (Electron) screen-OCR overlay tool for Japanese language learners (YomiNinja) — home/quick-configuration screen

view.name: Home
view.description: Main home screen with capture source, OCR engine, language and template selectors, release notes and hotkey hints.

regions.label: Dark app bar with hamburger 'open drawer' button, page title 'Home', and a refresh icon button at right
Icon-only vertical tablist (Home, OCR Templates, Extensions, Dictionaries, Settings, About) that expands to a labelled sidebar via the hamburger
Rounded dark panel: four outlined selects (Capture Source, Primary OCR Engine, OCR Language, OCR Template), outlined 'View overlay in your browser' button, and a bold 'New features' changelog list
Rounded dark panel listing overlay hotkeys as right-aligned labels with keycap chips, plus a bulleted tips list

evidence.note: Top app bar with page title and drawer toggle
Icon rail of fixed top-level destinations; hamburger expands it to show labels (verified live)

evidence.quote: HOME OCR TEMPLATES EXTENSIONS DICTIONARIES SETTINGS ABOUT
evidence.note: Implemented as role=tablist 'Vertical tabs example' with a tabpanel; selected tab has grey fill, blue text and right indicator bar

patterns.rationale: Hamburger 'open drawer' widens the docked rail into a labelled sidebar that pushes content; this is closer to a rail expand than a slide-in drawer.

evidence.note: 'open drawer' button; live click expanded the rail to 216px with labels, pushing main content
Outlined select with leading icon and floating label; opens a list of PaddleOCR / Google Cloud Vision / Google Lens / MangaOCR

patterns.rationale: Selects are MUI Autocomplete comboboxes (text input with clear ×), so typing filters options, but typing behavior was not exercised.

evidence.note: role=combobox input with Open button; live open showed selectable text and a clear × button

patterns.rationale: Home screen holds a small set of instantly-applied app options (capture source, OCR engine, language, template) without a save button; it is a quick-config panel rather than a full settings catalog (a separate Settings tab exists).

evidence.quote: Select a capture source and the language that matches its content

evidence.note: Labelled fields but no submit; values apply immediately, so coded as choice controls / settings instead

evidence.quote: The overlay can be operated by using the following hotkeys
evidence.note: Inline shortcut reference with keycap chips (Alt + Q or PrintScreen, ...)

evidence.quote: Achieve the lowest latency by using the PrintScreen key.

evidence.note: Large rounded paper surfaces are section containers, not item-summary cards
Changelog list is plain inline content, not an alert/callout

structure.layout: desktop app shell: top app bar, collapsible left icon rail (vertical tabs), single scrolling content column of two full-width rounded dark panels with centered narrow control stack

aesthetics.typography: Roboto throughout (Material UI): 20px/500 page title, 18-19px regular for panel intros and hotkey labels, 16px for field values and body lists, 14px/500 uppercase for buttons/tabs, ~12px floating field labels
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat scale, 12-20px; hierarchy comes mostly from weight (bold changelog list) and uppercase button text rather than size

notes: Stock Material UI dark theme (MUI v5): #121212 background, elevated paper with lighter overlay, #90caf9 primary blue for selected tab text and the outlined link-button. Narrow (~593px) centered column of outlined selects each with a leading filled icon. Hotkey table renders keys as small dark keycap chips with '+' separators. The changelog ('✨New features:') sits inside the home config panel in bold light-grey text. The tablist's accessible name is the leftover 'Vertical tabs example'.
